caption:
same 5x5, finally on a calendar that answers back

#gym #fitnessapp #soma

slides.text:
I didn't build a new plan

I *typed* the one I had

The 5x5 everyone runs

Twelve weeks, three days,
five sets of five

Auto-fill read it

Weeks, days, exercises —
set in one pass

Eight weeks, three days

On the calendar before
I closed the app

New app

Same plan you already
believe in

slides.heading: Your plan, kept
slides.body: Type or paste the program you already follow — SOMA fills the block and runs the schedule around your recovery
